headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text:
NOACN001. Summary: NO ACTION
Details: Thank you for your request. Street and Bridge Operations reviewed and confirmed gravel was found due to private or contractor being performed. Sweeper truck needed to clear gravel debris from the roadway. COMM group has been set to the Central District for additional attention and future maintenance. If you have any questions regarding this request, please …

Wtar bar at 1 Hotel, 96 Red River Street 
EXTREME bass playing on the rooftop, send someone there to SHUT THEM DOWN now, this is absurd. There’s no basic respect to the city law and residents nearby 
Are the ppl on the rooftop deaf with this volume ?

Why is no one ever working at the road closure near Menchaxa Rd. & St. Albans Blvd?  What are we doing?   It’s been weeks, let’s get those barricades down if no one is going to be working on it.  Let’s go, this is putting the whole community in a tough spot daily.   Please and thank you.

The street sweeper came on Tuesday morning, however, due to trash day and dumpsters being out on the street, much of the water, mud, and debris contributing to water pooling in front of 3324 and 3320 Autumn Bay Drive is still there. Could the street cleaner please take a 2nd pass at cleaning this hazardous waste from our curbside?

Extremely loud music from WATR bar. After all the complaints, the past few weeks they had moved their djs to inside or the opposite side of resident facing buildings which solved the music issue. But they moved it back tonight and again very high db levels. My room is shaking. Please follow up to have them move the dj location.

NOPROBLE. Summary: Not enough information
Details: Thank you for your request. Street and Bridge Operations reviewed but there is not enough infomation to proceed. Please create new request with more information. If you have any questions regarding this request, please contact Street and Bridge Operations Dispatch at (512) 974-8777 and provide work order number: 26-222487. .

Dip/bump on 12th St near Baylor. PLEASE smooth out this dip in the road left after construction on 12th. It’s damaging cars driving in either direction on 12th… it’s very hard to notice until you hit it. Thank you for putting up a sign warning about the bump.

Someone illegally dumped heavy metal trailer axles and miscellaneous debris inside the park along the wooden fence line near the manhole cover. There are fresh vehicle tire tracks leading from the commercial gate entrance off Ralph C. Craig, suggesting unauthorized vehicle access through the locked gate. Please remove the hazardous metal debris from the park grounds and check/re-secure the padl…

Pickup truck is parked right at the crosswalk on Donna Jane. Texas law requires 20ft buffer space by any crosswalk at an intersection. This is a T shape intersection with crosswalks on both roads. This is a problem spot that needs attention thank you

This car has been illegally parked outside of my residence (1145 1/2 Poquito St) all day today and is still parked there now. I need to bring out my trash tomorrow morning for pick up and I cannot place it because the car is illegally parked.

From 290 to Parmer, Harris branch parkway has cracks in the road like it’s got fault lines all over the place and there are way too many humps in the road that will damage a car if it hits it in the right spot…the cracks are separating the road really bad on both sides and needs to get repaired or something

(New pedestrian island on Bolm Rd) Traffic cones direct cars into bike lane and cars often don’t move back into car lane. Cones should direct cars back over to the correct lane so bikes resume right of way. Construction of pedestrian island seems to be complete so  lane re-striping needs to done.

Construction on lot next to us is blocking our cars parked in. There are rows of cars parked behind and blocking (red car in front is ours). The vehicles also block the area on our street where trash pickup occurs. In case of emergency we would be completely blocked in. This is a dead end street and our house is located somewhat beyond the dead end so we have minimal access to the street to beg…

Completed. Traffic heading east on metropolis at the intersection of metropolis and 183 is constantly stalled for extended periods of time during high traffic times (4pm, 4:30pm, 5pm). I have sat waiting for the light for over 15 minutes. The light timing for this road cannot support the amount of traffic that tries to move through this light. Can the light for this angle be extended at all?
Please send enforcement to W 6th St. Several new bars need to know that this is not the entertainment district. The music is too loud and based on previous experience will be past midnight tonight.

8:30 at night on a Sunday and can still hear this band full blast. Trying to go to bed! Desperate for the city of Austin to uphold the sound ordinance - particularly on a Sunday night when we have to work in the morning
Raised utility cut causing hazard when driven over.  This whole area is dangerous because our lane ends and cars are coming at us head on.  They got rid of our lane.  Utility cut needs fixing too

Late-Night Noise Complaint — 78724
On November 22, 2026, starting around 10:30 PM and continuing past midnight, loud amplified music with heavy bass has been coming from a residence on the side of Purple Sage Drive opposite the LBJ school field, clearly audible from Durango Pass well inside overnight quiet hours.

A Mercedes Benz is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed.

I think they should put lights under the over pass bridge under Cesar chavez and IH-35. It’s too dark. One time there was an accident under there and the in coming traffic couldn’t see it coming so they collided with the accident.

Watr rooftop at 96 Red River St, extreme heavy bass started blasting after 10pm - looks like they’re going till 1/2 am as advertised on their website 
I’m sitting in my bed with PJ on not able to sleep at all, the sound is penetrating through sealed window 
Pls go onsite to investigate and shut them down now, and their permit should be invoked by now which the amount of residents affected and t…

Plz send enforcement. Many new bars on W 6th who don’t seem to know that music has an end time of 11pm on Thursday. This is not E 6th. Which bar is unknown. Our understanding is the after the end time there will not be any sound or music from W  6th St bars.

Loud live music has been playing for a few hours already. I cannot see, where the music is coming from but it is very close. It’s possible a building is blocking my view. I can hear the singer singing and the audience cheering very loudly to my home in 303 W 5st (Hanover Republiq Square). My home is facing north (5th st).

Three German shepherds are out and about. My neighbor just said they attacked his rooster and killed it.
These dogs get out on a regular basis.

Animal control was out here last month and talked to the owner who lives up somewhere on Walnut Ridge or one of the cul-de-sacs off of it.  Animal control told me this is an ongoing issue with these dogs and has warned the owner.

These photos were tak…

12001 Dessau Rd. Building 12, unsure if apartment number, second floor. I’m almost positive that there is a dog that is kept on an apartment patio all day. I see/hear him every time I’m outside. Recently, the resident put cardboard up against their patio so you can’t see in.

I have previously reported this dog and his mother. They were both out again today but I did not have my phone. This is from two weeks ago when I saw him and they are out often roaming the streets. His penis is extremely swollen and when I previously reported his mother had a horrible rash. Last time I saw him he was with a younger puppy as well. I am concerned for the well being of these dogs …

White pit bull that lives outside in all weather conditions with a dog house that is too small for its size so she is always exposed to weather/elements and does not always have water. I understand that it is legal for a dog to live outside, however this dog is not being properly cared for and is at risk.

A vehicle is currently parked within an active Texas Gas Service construction work area. I spoke with nearby residents who stated that the vehicle has reportedly been abandoned for over a year. The vehicle is obstructing the planned work area and must be removed to allow our crews to safely perform the required excavation and construction activities.
We are requesting assistance with arranging …

On the north side of Shamrock Blvd (near 2305 Shamrock Blvd), construction vehicles consistently park in the “No Parking” side of the street” which chokes the already narrow street. I have asked them to move, but they consistently park here even when parking is available on Bowling Green Drive. Additionally, they block the other side of the street with cones.

The city made a “walkway” using 46th street from Ave A to H. Now you don’t maintain it, grass is growing in it between A and B. People don’t use it. All you did was force more people into traffic. You made it impossible for the normal street sweeper to clean. And you don’t bother sending the specialty sweeper. You made this stupid fake sidewalk, it’s your responsibility to clean it up.

Address is airport and Guadeloupe, not what I have on the map here. The green left turn never comes. This has happened to me twice this year. I waited eight minutes through multiple signals and never got a green left turn. It stayed red. I’m unsure what direction I was facing. I tried to fill this out how I could.

Car parked too far from curb, impeding access down the dead end street when other cars are parked across from it. Waste collection had to walk all bins to the end of the street this morning to collect them.

the light now takes a crazy long time to turn green. It did not used to take this long to turn red and the other lights on the street do not. Something is wrong with the light and it is causing an extremely heavy traffic backup each day

Watr rooftop at 1 Hotel, 96 Red River street - blasting heavy bass again, they go louder as it gets later in the night - advertised to go on till 1/2 am 

They clearly don’t care about the ‘inspection’ or ‘conversation’ with management

Mama dearest is playing loud music with their door open, that can be heard inside, they have repeatedly been asked to close the door by sound enforcement and neighbors but continue to let the music resonate through our community
Street cleaner needed to sweep small lake in road which has dirt and mud. Bugs and other debris is being collected due to stagnant water after rains and poor draining. Street level up needed.

Extremely loud music again from WATR bar. They were cited a citation yesterday that the db levels were too high and that they would make changes. But they obviously haven’t. My apartment is shaking again.
My neighbor regularly blows grass clippings and leaves into the street and gutters while mowing. The debris enters storm drains and spreads onto neighboring properties. Please investigate.

Watr’s bass is shaking our apartment. Please tell them to turn it down. It’s way louder than normal. 

They advertise music til 1 AM, but their permit’s cutoff is midnight
Dempsey lane and Tetbury lane. Homeowner using the street near the intersection to renovate a travel trailer. An already difficult intersection to navigate has become hazardous and unsafe
